answer_1.quote: Generate (a) the response argument graph A consisting of A_arg (nodes)-the response arguments and their claim/premise labels, A_rel (edges)-the inter and intra-attack and support relationships, and (b) the response text R.
answer_1.outputs: Generated persuasive counter-responses to misinformation and hate speech.

answer_2.quote: Table : Generated vs Gold Text compares the average BLEU and Rouge-L scores between the original and generated response text using the test set instructions.

answer_4.quote: We evaluated the six responses using two AMT evaluators per sample, and paid 2 cents each. Given a misinformation post, the evaluators ranked the responses (1=best, 6=worst) for (i) Engagingness: How likely will the response evoke a follow-up reply from the misinformant? (ii) Naturalness: Does the counter-response naturally follow from the context? (iii) Factualness: Is the response factual?
answer_4.guideline: Rank responses (1=best, 6=worst) based on Engagingness, Naturalness, and Factualness
